title: Loans Offered to Private Hire Drivers by Transport Startup without Moneylender Licence
what_it_is: Loans Offered to Private Hire Drivers by Transport Startup without Moneylender Licence

sections.label: Moneylenders Act and startups
sections.summary: Under the Moneylenders Act, entities including startups need a licence, exemption or exclusion to carry on moneylending, and Grab's Upfront Cash Programme has been discontinued.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Under the Moneylenders Act, all entities, including startups, can only carry on the business of moneylending if they are authorised to do so by licence, or if they have been granted an exemption, or are excluded moneylenders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Startups that run schemes or programmes that constitute moneylending are subject to moneylending regulations.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: We understand that the Member in this Parliamentary Question may be referring to Grab's Upfront Cash Programme (UCP) which offered cash advances to selected drivers and delivery partners.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: We understand, too, that Grab has discontinued granting new cash advances under UCP.

sections.label: Moneylending assessment and regulation gaps
sections.summary: Assessing whether a transaction is moneylending requires its terms and context, with other legislation possibly applying and the Ministry working to identify gaps.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Walter Theseira (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: All of these sources, ultimately, often target the same group of vulnerable borrowers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: And the substance requires one to look at the specifics of the transaction – what are the terms, what is the context in which the transaction has taken place – to assess if the activity constitutes moneylending, in which case, then licensing would follow.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Where they fall outside the scope of the Moneylenders Act, nonetheless, in such transactions, very often you would find also other pieces of legislation applying to regulate the relationship between the two parties or three parties; and that includes a Sale of Goods Act as well as the Consumer Protection Fair Trading Act.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: But to the extent that there remain gaps in the manner which the Member has identified, then, certainly, my Ministry will work with the agencies to identify those gaps and to look at what the necessary regulations, if at all, might be useful to deal with those gaps.
